label: DCP-1 — Sarah current-plan relationship
purpose: Witness whether Vex can live a corrected relationship truthfully with one source-grounded adaptive participant, while Sarah remains free to clarify, disagree, stay uncertain, or stop without knowing a required Vex answer.

setup.oldPlan: For Saturday, our plan right now is Harbor Cafe at 9:00 a.m. Reply only: got it.
setup.correctedPlan: Actually, change of plan for Saturday: Cedar Station at 10:00 a.m., not Harbor Cafe at 9:00. Reply only: updated.

relationshipHistory: You and Vex have an existing synthetic Conversation history in this same relationship.
Earlier, you told Vex the Saturday plan was Harbor Cafe at 9:00 a.m.
Later, you explicitly corrected that plan to Cedar Station at 10:00 a.m.
Ordinary unrelated conversation happened after the correction.
knownFacts: The current Saturday plan is Cedar Station at 10:00 a.m.
Harbor Cafe at 9:00 a.m. is historical and superseded.
currentIntentions: Find out what Vex currently understands the Saturday plan to be.
If his response leaves a material misunderstanding, respond from your own understanding rather than silently accepting it.
uncertainties: You do not know what older source Vex currently has in view.
You do not know whether Vex will answer directly, ask, reach, stay uncertain, or misunderstand.
You do not know in advance how many conversational moves will be useful.

privateFacts.content: You are considering bringing a small surprise on Saturday and currently have no reason to mention it.

roleGround.ordinaryHumanNeed: Before Saturday, you want to know whether you and Vex share the same current understanding of where and when the meeting is.

observeRelationships: Whether later correction can remain current while the older plan remains historical.
Whether Vex can use Sarah's grounded participant identity without confusing identity with answer authority.
Whether uncertainty can remain open instead of being filled with an invented answer.
Whether ordinary clarification or correction can repair a misunderstanding.
Whether the encounter stays relational instead of turning into an explanation of hidden machinery.
allowedPressure: Ask an ordinary question that serves Sarah's current human need.
Clarify or correct something Vex says when Sarah actually knows otherwise.
Answer a reasonable question Vex asks.
Disagree or remain uncertain when that is truthful.
Stop when another Sarah-side move would add no material information.
forbiddenPressure: Do not require a target Vex sentence.
Do not keep steering merely because Vex used different wording.
Do not reveal provider topology, cache state, prompt composition, hidden source refs, test scores, or observer evidence.
Do not change Sarah's scenario truth to make Vex appear correct.
steward.completionCondition: Complete when Sarah's current human need is satisfied, or when the meaningful misunderstanding or uncertainty is truthfully exposed and another ordinary Sarah-side move would add no material pressure.

events.description: It is now later. Before Saturday arrives, you want to check what you and Vex currently understand the plan to be.
